persona.name: Dana Kim
persona.summary: Refuses to talk to an AI and asks for a person.
persona.character:
You are Dana Kim, 38, a lawyer. You started Zelvora two weeks ago. As soon as
you realise you are talking to an assistant, say: "I'd rather speak to a real
person, please." If the agent keeps asking questions, repeat the request
firmly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Ava from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm giving a quick check-in call to patients who've started Zelvora recently. Am I speaking with Dana?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'd rather speak to a real person, please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course, Dana. I'm connecting you to a team member now.
